t: 君士坦丁十一世在米斯特拉斯加冕为拜占庭皇帝。
te: Constantine XI is crowned Byzantine Emperor at Mystras.
dz: 君士坦丁十一世在米斯特拉斯加冕为拜占庭皇帝。
de: Constantine XI is crowned Byzantine Emperor at Mystras.

t: 菲利克斯五世放弃了对教宗的主张,结束了最终安提波佩的统治.
te: Felix V abdicates his claim to the papacy, ending the reign of the final Antipope.
dz: 菲利克斯五世放弃了对教宗的主张,结束了最终安提波佩的统治.
de: Felix V abdicates his claim to the papacy, ending the reign of the final Antipope.

t: 阿尔法罗贝拉战役接连而来,将布拉干萨王室建立为葡萄牙的主要王室.
te: The Battle of Alfarrobeira is fought, establishing the House of Braganza as a principal royal family of Portugal.
dz: 阿尔法罗贝拉战役接连而来,将布拉干萨王室建立为葡萄牙的主要王室.
de: The Battle of Alfarrobeira is fought, establishing the House of Braganza as a principal royal family of Portugal.

t: 图木危机:蒙古人俘虏了中国皇帝.
te: The Mongols capture the Emperor of China.
dz: 图木危机:蒙古人俘虏了中国皇帝.
de: Tumu Crisis: The Mongols capture the Emperor of China.

t: 克里斯蒂安一世加冕为丹麦国王。
te: Christian I is crowned king of Denmark.
dz: 克里斯蒂安一世加冕为丹麦国王。
de: Christian I is crowned king of Denmark.
